read: The board leans risk-off: BTC, ETH and SOL sit in 1d breakdowns while HYPE runs against it. The largest imbalances are shared shorts in BNB (funding -30.82, CEX -38.49) and the HL-local premium in TRX.

watchlist.note: Funding -30.82 (7d percentile 8) with CEX at -38.49, so the crowding is shared, not HL-local. ret24h -6.05 on a 1d breakdown with volRatio 50.69; the last BNB long was stopped, so we lean toward waiting for a reclaim.
watchlist.arms: a 1d close back above the 1d low20 with funding still under -10 and a level in the menu at least 2R away

watchlist.note: Funding -492.77 against CEX -24.46 and premium -48.87 bps on thin OI (19373366 USD, oiChg4h +8.54). Looks like a local dislocation; low-confidence read, risk skews to a snap-back.
watchlist.arms: OI above 30000000 USD with funding staying under -10 and a level in the menu at least 2R away

watchlist.note: ret24h -12.37 and ret7d -21.41, 4h vsSma20Atr -3.08, with oiChg4h +7.27 and HL funding 10.95 against CEX -24.96. Extended; a bounce is the base case but price has not reclaimed anything.
watchlist.arms: a 4h close back above the 4h low20 with funding still under 10.95 and a level in the menu at least 2R away

watchlist.note: HL funding 10.95 vs CEX -43.52 (gap 54.47), 1d rangePos 0.17 after a down breakout, ret4h +4.8 with ret7d -11.3. The CEX side is the crowded short; we lean toward a squeeze if 1d reclaims the range.
watchlist.arms: a 1d close back above the 1d low20 with CEX funding still negative and a level in the menu at least 2R away

watchlist.note: ret24h +17.78, 1d breakout up with volRatio 6.64 and 4h vsSma20Atr 2.78, but funding is back at 10.95 after funding24h 55.49, so the crowding premise has reset. Extended; the fade is not armed.
watchlist.arms: a 4h close back under the 4h high20 with funding back above 30 and a level in the menu at least 2R away

brief: Delta: ZRO short was cancelled last run when HL funding fell back to CEX (L2). BTC, ETH, SOL and BNB all print 1d breakdowns while HYPE (ret24h +17.78) runs against the board; its funding has reset to 10.95, so the fade stays unarmed. New: XMR htf_pullback long, the only tripwire hit, low conviction. BNB funding -30.82 is shared with CEX, which we read as squeeze fuel only after a reclaim. kPEPE short stays triggered with HL-local funding 40.58 vs CEX 5.65. Gap: hl-cycles is stale; OI 24h changes are null. Wrong if XMR loses the 1d SMA50.
